---
title: Ham Puff Pastry Bites
id: MAR-0072
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 60
difficulty: medium
---
## Ingredients
- 250 g of puff pastry
- 150 g of cooked ham
- 100 g of ricotta romana
- 2 egg yolks
- 5 tablespoons of fresh cream
- 1 tablespoon of brandy
## Method
1. Put the ham with the ricotta, one egg yolk, the brandy and the cream in a blender.
2. Blend until smooth.
3. Roll out the pastry into a thin sheet and cut out discs of 8 cm diameter with a fluted cutter.
4. Place half of the discs on the baking sheet lined with the appropriate paper, and place the ham cream in the center.
5. Cover with the remaining discs, pressing the edges, and brush them with the egg yolk.
6. Bake in the oven at 180 °C for about 20 minutes, until they are golden.
